public_sources.title: archiki/GrIPS run_search.py
public_sources.mechanism_used: implements delete/swap/substitute/add edit operators, scores generated candidates, accepts a new base only on strict score improvement, and otherwise advances a patience counter before stopping

distinctness_check.claim_scope: No prior GrIPS binding was found by the exact own-namespace code search; GitHub marked the search incomplete, so this is not a proof of global absence.

chat_native_reduction.reason_literal_runtime_not_required: The public implementation depends on task datasets, model scoring, Python packages and optionally an API key/GPU. The current leaf audits the edit-search mechanism under scheduled Chat, where a deterministic role-local state machine can exercise the transferable logic without those external execution requirements.
state_machine: Restrict delete/add/swap/paraphrase operations to a mutable role-local strategy-instruction layer; frozen control, CLEAN isolation, semantic-input policy, authority boundary and credit policy are immutable edit masks.
Seal an edit identity before evaluation so restart resumes the same pending child rather than generating a different edit.
A deleted mutable phrase enters a role-local tombstone; add may only restore an exact tombstoned mutable phrase, preventing feedback from inventing protected semantics.
A generated child is UNEVALUATED and receives zero score/credit until its own terminal semantic evidence is durably read back.
Tool/transport failures are mechanical QC and do not become semantic candidate scores.
Only same-scope evaluated candidates are comparable; incomparable scopes remain unranked.
Promote only on strict utility improvement, mirroring GrIPS' strict best_score > base_score update; ties/regressions keep the parent.
After a frozen patience limit of non-improving evaluated edits, stop this edit search and switch to the next predeclared frontier rather than accepting a worse child.
Terminal frontier closure is credited at most once and is separate from whether the edited child becomes incumbent.

constructed_conformance.implementation: deterministic transition function executed in the current Chat Python tool; no external model calls

ablation.removed_guards: immutable edit mask, pending-child resume, mechanical-failure no-score rule, strict-improvement requirement

exact_scope_result.supported_claim: A bounded GrIPS-style edit search can be reduced to the current scheduled-Chat controller while preserving restart identity, CLEAN/authority boundaries, evidence-before-score/credit, same-scope ranking, strict-improvement switching and patience-based exit on the 12 constructed guards.
unsupported_claims: No claim that the original GrIPS benchmark was reproduced.
No claim that GrIPS is superior to MIPROv2, ProTeGi or other public optimizers on real tasks.
No claim that GitHub code search proved global novelty.
No claim that a generated natural-language edit was evaluated on a real external workload in this leaf.
